findings.title: Large modules need extraction seams
findings.detail: Large Python modules are harder for local models to reason over and slower to test in focused slices: winlocalassistant\core.py, winlocalassistant\tools.py, winlocalassistant\webui.py
findings.recommendation: Prefer additive extraction around stable seams: routing tables, GUI command metadata, media planning, and audits should live in smaller modules with focused tests.

findings.title: Broad exceptions still hide repair evidence
findings.detail: Found 321 broad exception handlers without structured logging. Examples: scripts\run_gui_runtime_test.py:31, scripts\run_gui_runtime_test.py:197, scripts\run_gui_runtime_test.py:200, scripts\run_gui_runtime_test.py:205, winlocalassistant\action_watcher.py:120, winlocalassistant\adaptive_backlog.py:31, winlocalassistant\analytics_engine.py:113, winlocalassistant\analytics_engine.py:140, winlocalassistant\analytics_engine.py:165, winlocalassistant\analytics_engine.py:235
findings.recommendation: Replace bare `except Exception: pass` with structured warning records so mistake-learning and self-repair can learn the root cause.

findings.title: Monolithic GUI file is a regression risk
findings.detail: webui.py is 438,154 characters. Small CSS/JS patches become fragile and hard to visually verify.
findings.recommendation: Move command palette metadata, layout CSS, media widgets and voice/state panels toward separate templates/modules while preserving existing routes.

research_signals.relevance: Ollama exposes keep_alive, stream=false, JSON/structured outputs and final timing fields such as eval_count/eval_duration.
research_signals.nova_action: Keep queueing same-model calls, use stream=false for tool JSON, and record token/s for model benchmark history.

research_signals.relevance: Quantization, partial GPU offload, KV-cache choices and speculative decoding are core local-inference efficiency levers.
research_signals.nova_action: Keep high-spec and fallback model profiles separate; add future GGUF/llama.cpp profile export rather than hard-coding only Ollama.

research_signals.relevance: Screenshot baselines catch GUI regressions that unit tests miss.
research_signals.nova_action: Keep optional Playwright visual tests and add a calm-layout screenshot smoke test for the chat/drawers/popups.

research_signals.relevance: Spans and structured events make failures visible across agent, tool, model and GUI layers.
research_signals.nova_action: Continue replacing silent exceptions with structured events that self-repair can consume.

recommended_validation: Run a focused pytest slice for changed GUI/media/model files.
Run /nova-efficiency-audit after major patches and attach the generated docs to release notes.
Use /llm-status to ensure same-model prompts are queued, not overlapped.
Use optional Playwright visual smoke tests before changing GUI layout again.
